introduction: Original music for advertising, film, orchestra, and multimedia performance.

works.title: Project Zi
works.description: Original music for a campaign film for Hongzi Gabrielle Jiang.

works.title: Gu Shi
works.description: Official trailer for Amie Song’s feature film, published by La Biennale di Venezia. The film was selected for the 2026 Venice International Film Festival and Busan International Film Festival.

works.title: Ephemeral Bloom
works.description: Inspired by Wang Wei’s poem Xin Yi Wu (The Magnolia Dale), the work explores the fleeting life of magnolia blossoms through orchestral colour. Premiered by the Seattle Festival Orchestra in 2024.

works.title: I wrote you a letter.
works.subtitle: (a letter is what I wrote to you.)
works.description: A work for two pianos, typewriter, and multimedia, commissioned by House on Fire. Instrumental writing meets the physical sound and action of typing in a live performance setting.
